title: Crispy French Walnut Cookies
description: Classic French cookies with a crunchy walnut twist. Enjoy as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl.
Add the softened butter to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Stir in the crushed cookies, chopped walnuts, and crispy fried onions.
Beat in the eggs until the dough is smooth.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Cut into desired shapes using a cookie cutter.
Place the cookies on the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch of space between each cookie.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
